notes.title: BIG Multiplayer-Update (Part 1)!
notes.notes:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44925861/13b77d4dd3c09ab2a8053c86d47ee6437bb71b6f.png

Hello dear spirits 👻,
the big multiplayer update is finally here! After a few more delays, you can now experience unforgettable rounds together with your friends! This is all new in the update:

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44925861/07d4e7ce95b6a4cae2b2780cf1ead8bba39cef7f.png

Multiplayer rounds and parties

Create or join parties to play various The Land of Magic game modes together in multiplayer! When creating the party, you can make any settings you like, such as the visibility from public to private. Private parties can be joined using special room codes. All public parties are listed accordingly, allowing any player to join any party. If all this takes too long, you can also play quickmatches by immediately searching for other random players to quickly start a random round! Play up to four different game modes with your friends: High Out, Time Worlds, Star Marathon and Secret Obstacles! More game modes coming in Multiplayer Update Part 2!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44925861/6a77a0714a6111c6b8b21a63694e8b34709c05e4.png

New season and events

The second season has begun and new rewards can be earned accordingly. Complete tasks, master worlds or play multiplayer rounds! Buy the Season Star to get more special benefits.
A new event is also being added: for every multiplayer round you play, you will receive secret rewards until April 1st!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44925861/fb888fc777489f136285b4828e58c30d82379b36.png

Further improvements and bug fixes

Many other improvements have been made such as:
1. atmospheric music in some worlds. You can control whether this function should be on or off with a toggle.
2. outlines for players and monsters when they are hidden by objects.
3. improved and reworked filters and effects for each scene
4. smarter monsters: any monster with an extra attack, such as: jump or teleport, will be done immediately when the monster is blocked.
5. if you are represented in leaderboards, this is now also synchronized via Steam.
6. more and new, as well as extended graphics settings have now been added.

Various bug fixes:
1. not resetting the daily challenge processes and the relay hunt has been fixed.
2. the missing equipping of hats has been fixed.
3. the button animations have been adjusted so that they are no longer grayed out if you have already pressed them once.
4. the display of various windows in the menu has now been adjusted at the beginning so that windows that are no longer relevant or active should no longer open. The probability has also been reduced.

Further bug fixes have been made and implemented. For further sightings, please contact our support - Thank you! 
You can also watch the following video:
[previewyoutube=rdcaigQv2A4;full][/previewyoutube]
We also ask for your feedback so that we can make The Land of Magic as good as possible!

 - Your The Land of Magic team!

notes.title: The Christmas update!
notes.notes:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44925861/72abcbd9cb77255792163095e93c581a0c7b5057.png

The Christmas update

Dear Spirits,
in this update we have made many different adjustments and bug fixes. This is the update list, we hope you enjoy it!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44925861/ad141a6e7199403d755ece43aa5c4cfda2dd20a6.png

Christmas!

Experience the most magical time of the year in The Land of Magic with Christmas decorations and Christmas music! As always, we have adapted the game to the season!

Christmas Event

There is also a special event at the end of the year. Master the Christmas world to unlock mysterious rewards. A maximum of 50 mysterious rewards can be collected!

Steam Cloud

The Land of Magic now supports Steam Cloud! All your game saves are now synchronized with your Steam profile and loaded from other devices.

Upcoming update

We actually have a new feature planned for the Christmas update: Multiplayer! However, this feature will now be postponed to the beginning of next year. That's why this update came a little later than usual. We ask for your understanding!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44925861/eb074174ff422fd26872cef42d164e852ef089fa.png

We wish you a Merry Christmas and a Happy New Year! We hope to see you in the game again next year for the big multiplayer update! Take care!

Your MagicAme-Team!

notes.title: New 1.1 Update - Leaderboards!
notes.notes:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44925861/fc25a543578e5b3056d1d9936d0c8260f6417a66.png

The improved First World
In the First World, the guides have been made clearer and simpler. Now every monster is explained and you now have enough time to read and understand everything in peace. The world has been shortened in general. Now the First World is no longer the longest.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44925861/fb888fc777489f136285b4828e58c30d82379b36.png

Leaderboards for all game modes
Leaderboards are now finally available for all game modes! In Worlds mode, your entire mastered worlds are displayed, in High Out your high score in the current league and the high scores for all daily challenges. The high score for the current season is also displayed. You can view all leaderboards in your profile under leaderboards.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44925861/f89e744a7b0aa9363dccc57434dad613cb954033.png

New news and announcements
For all those who have purchased The Land of Magic, you will receive a free gift in the News section under Messages, worth the value of the game. You can claim this once. We thank everyone who bought the game on Steam. NOW it is available for FREE and we are looking forward to more players and interest! After a long break from the game, you will also get one-time rewards, as a restart so to speak.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44925861/13b77d4dd3c09ab2a8053c86d47ee6437bb71b6f.png

Further bug fixes and improvements
Further bug fixes have been made:
 - You now have to play through the First World at the beginning to get to the menu, even if you quit and restart the game in the meantime.
 - Offers windows are now displayed less frequently and only when no tutorial window or event window is active and you have at least a level of 3 - 4.
 - The snail will now warn you one second in advance where it will be teleported with an effect.
 - The bug of not resetting to the last checkpoint on red platforms has been fixed.
 - Fixed the ad blocker display.
 - New controls have been added to the settings.
 - The layout of the profile has been revised.
 - New variations in the First and Second World are available.
 - Timer fixes for the graveyard event have been fixed.

If you have any further error messages or problems, please contact our support team. They will help you immediately during working days. Thank you very much!

-Your MagicAme team!

notes.title: Bug fixes and improvements
notes.notes:
We have made several bug fixes and improvements to make the game experience safer and bug free.

The following fixes and improvements have been made:
1. wrong font replaced to the correct one: a title text had a wrong font in the UI to select a random world.
2. secure currency system: We have implemented new security measures against currency hacking. Unfortunately, these changes have resulted in a reset of all existing currencies.
3. new level achieved UI has been added: Previously, when you reached a new level, you were not notified that a new level had been reached. Now a UI will tell you when you reach a new level.
4. instructions and keyboard guides have been edited: In the guide in the first world, the text has been edited to make the guide as easy to understand as possible. In addition, the key assignment for sneaking has been added to the keyboard guides.
5. fixed graphical errors: In the second world, there was an obstacle that flickered. This graphical bug has now been fixed.
6. purchase options have been added to the Season Shop: Clicking on a plus will display purchase options, for further acquisition of points. Two offers are currently available, which can also be accessed normally in the store.
7. general improvements in the UI: We have made many different UI improvements in various scenes.
8. further bug fixes: Many small, other bugs have been reworked.

If you have any further bugs, please contact our support.
Thank you very much!
